title: list_forces: a line for each task force with a ship afloat, and for each land unit

land_units.description: The side's own land units (decision 0066, 21), in the area if one is given. Left out when the side has none.

submarines.description: The side's own submarines (decision 0218), those held apart, sunk or gone home among them. Left out when the side has none.

to_enter.description: The side's own forces and units held apart until their day (decision 0195, 7): not on the map, so not in task_forces or land_units. In the area if one is given. Left out when none is held.
